items.exampleEn: Rents for waterfront apartments are very high.
items.exampleZh: 濱水公寓的房租非常高。

items.exampleEn: We spent the afternoon at the city aquarium.
items.exampleZh: 我們在市立水族館待了一個下午。

items.exampleEn: The painting shows a panorama of the whole valley.
items.exampleZh: 這幅畫描繪了整個山谷的全景。

items.exampleEn: The hotel restaurant has panoramic windows.
items.exampleZh: 飯店的餐廳有全景式的窗戶。

items.exampleEn: We stopped at a wayside cafe for a cup of coffee.
items.exampleZh: 我們在一家路邊的咖啡館停下來喝杯咖啡。

items.exampleEn: Suburbia grew quickly after cars became common.
items.exampleZh: 汽車普及之後，郊區迅速發展起來。

items.exampleEn: The palace grounds are open to the public on Sundays.
items.exampleZh: 王宮的庭園每逢星期天對外開放。

items.sentenceEn: Visitors are not allowed to smoke anywhere on the school grounds.
items.sentenceZh: 訪客不准在校園內任何地方吸菸。

items.audioEn: The new aquarium has a glass tunnel where big fish swim over your head.
items.audioZh: 新的水族館有一條玻璃隧道，大魚就在你頭頂上游過。
items.questionZh: 新的水族館有什麼特色？

items.sentenceEn: My neighbor keeps tropical fish in an aquarium in his bedroom.
items.sentenceZh: 我鄰居在他臥室的魚缸裡養熱帶魚。

items.sentenceEn: From the top of the tower, you get a panoramic view of the city.
items.sentenceZh: 從塔頂可以看到城市的全景。

items.stemEn: Many families leave the city for the quiet life of ____.
items.stemZh: 許多家庭離開城市，去過郊區的寧靜生活。

items.stemEn: Many small shops have fallen by the ____ since the mall opened.
items.stemZh: 購物中心開幕以來，許多小店都被淘汰了。

items.passageEn: Ten years ago, our city's waterfront was full of empty old buildings. Today it is the most popular part of town. The city built a large aquarium, a park, and a hotel whose top floor offers a stunning panorama of the harbor. The grounds of the old fish market now host a weekend food fair, and amateur musicians play there every Sunday. Many residents who had moved to suburbia are coming back to live in new apartments near the water. Not every plan succeeded, though: an idea for a cable car fell by the wayside because it was too expensive.
items.passageZh: 十年前，我們城市的濱水區到處是空蕩的舊建築。如今，那裡是全城最熱門的地方。市府蓋了一座大型水族館、一座公園，還有一間頂樓能欣賞港口壯麗全景的飯店。舊魚市場的場地現在每逢週末舉辦美食市集，每個星期天還有業餘樂手在那裡表演。許多搬到郊區的居民，紛紛回來住進水邊的新公寓。不過，並不是每個計畫都成功：興建纜車的構想因為太貴而被放棄了。

questions.questionZh: 舊魚市場的場地現在用來做什麼？
options: 改建成大型室內停車場

questions.questionZh: 纜車的構想後來怎麼了？

items.promptZh: 我們沿著海濱散步，看夕陽。
referenceEn: We walked along the waterfront and watched the sunset.
We took a walk along the waterfront to watch the sunset.
rubricZh: waterfront 表示「海濱、濱水區」，用法例如 along the waterfront、by the waterfront 等
時態配合內容（例如 walked、take a walk 等）
「看夕陽」可寫，例如 watch the sunset、see the sunset 等

items.promptZh: 這部小說描寫郊區生活的寂寞。
referenceEn: This novel describes the loneliness of life in suburbia.
The novel is about how lonely life in suburbia can be.
rubricZh: 「郊區生活」用 suburbia，例如 life in suburbia 等
「描寫」可寫，例如 describes、is about、shows 等
「寂寞」可寫，例如 loneliness、how lonely… 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：wayside 釋義只有「路邊（的）；路旁」，但 mcq（items/12）與短文都考慣用語 fall by the wayside「被淘汰、半途而廢」，屬另一詞義；依 §11-5 本課用到的詞義要在釋義並列，或 mcq 改考「路邊」義。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改「路邊（的）；半途被淘汰」，把 fall by the wayside 的詞義並列（第一義仍是例句的「路邊」）；雙義干擾項同步改格式；mcq 與閱讀考的慣用語義已在釋義內

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：承上：mcq 考的是 fall by the wayside 慣用語，單字卡沒教此義，只看英文的學習者無從由本課釋義推得；且 grounds／waterfront 代入 fallen by the ___ 文法上也成立，僅靠慣用語排除。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義已並列「被淘汰」義；只看英文時 fallen by the grounds／waterfront 都不通，mcq 保留

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：跟讀與 aquarium 卡雷同（spend time at the aquarium）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 My neighbor keeps tropical fish in an aquarium in his bedroom.（第二義「魚缸」）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：同詞性 mcq 只有不可數的 suburbia 能放進 the quiet life of ____，冠詞／可數性洩題
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 干擾項換成不可數的 pathos、stamina、unison，代入後語意都不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 15：聽選本批正解集中在最長與最短
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 正解改 A tunnel of glass，改為第 3 長

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「常用 along the waterfront」未加「例如／等」，屬 §11-23 封閉寫法；建議「（例如 along the waterfront、by the waterfront 等）」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示評分要點統一改「例如…等」：waterfront 表示「海濱、濱水區」，用法例如 along the waterfront、by the waterfront 等／時態配合內容（例如 walked、take a walk 等）／「看夕陽」可寫，例如 watch the sunset、see the sunset 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：waterfront 表示「海濱、濱水區」，用法例如 along the waterfront、by the waterfront 等／時態配合內容（例如 walked、take a walk 等）／「看夕陽」可寫，例如 watch the sunset、see the sunset 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：suburbia 是不可數名詞，表示「郊區（生活）」（例如 in suburbia、life in suburbia 等）／句子要說到你自己的看法或經驗
